_why: PROVISIONAL (9 Nov 2026). `limit` is what the app does today plus a little room: it must not get worse, and nothing is cut to meet it. `goal` is the research target (docs/LESSONS.md): the script reports screens above it but does not fail. Tighten `limit` toward `goal` after the phone baseline (docs/perf-baseline.md). A new look that breaks `limit` is changed, not the number. Frame limits are huge on purpose: headless runs on software GL (a few hundred ms per frame is normal there), so they only catch a catastrophe; real frame rate is the phone baseline.
